newsitem.title: USA: Myriad not to proceed with public offer.
newsitem.headline: Myriad not to proceed with public offer.

text.p: Myriad Genetics Inc said on Monday it did not plan to proceed with its proposed public common stock offering because conditions were not favorable at the moment.

On November 15, the company said it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to offer 1.7 million shares of its common stock. Of those shares, the company said it would sell 1.5 million shares and certain stockholders would sell 200,000 shares.
But Myriad, a gene discovery and genetic testing company, said on Monday it withdrew the registration statement with the SEC and that the entire offering had been cancelled.
